views.rationale: GOOGL revenue fell 2% YoY, whereas JNJ reported a 3.8% decline in worldwide sales for the first half of 2020
GOOGL’s modest 2% revenue decline contrasts with KO’s qualitative statement of a significant drop in away‑from‑home channel sales due to COVID‑19
PG net sales rose 4.8% to $70.95B and earnings margin jumped to 18.5% versus NEE revenue falling from $4.5B to $4.1B (≈9% decline)
